constraints.rule: USART3 is shared. Select J69/J70 or J84/J85; do not tie two external TX outputs onto PB11.
J40 3-5/4-6 selects 485; 5-7/6-8 selects RS232. USART2 TX on PA2 conflicts with Ethernet MDIO.
CAN and audio I2S cannot operate on these pins simultaneously.
Both are hard-wired; no software-only independent control.
Shared net; external drive can conflict with IMU output.
Shared with an onboard output; check board isolation before driving XCLK.
Use SWD without SWO to free PB3/PB4; full JTAG conflicts with SPI Flash.
Same USB FS data pair; connect/use only one role at a time.
Shared I2C bus with parallel pull-ups. Use distinct 7-bit addresses; check camera address/pull-ups.
Each port has a fixed 120-ohm board termination; count it in total bus termination.
Install J40 1-2 to supply CAN/485 logic; other routes do not supply it.
FireDAP VREF is target-voltage reference. Supply board separately; do not assume probe powers it.
3.3V logic. Only datasheet-designated FT inputs tolerate 5V under stated conditions; analog inputs must stay within VDDA. RS232 voltages never connect directly to GPIO.

constraintScope: Excluded peripherals are named only where they electrically share a modeled signal; their interfaces/behavior are not modeled.

touch.relationship: Uses LCD/touch expansion resources; resolve exact fitted controller and connector route before generating a driver

ethernet.note: PG11 is authoritative for TX_EN; a historical PB11 comment is incorrect

camera.rule: Allocate the complete DCMI signal set from vendorIoRows and the fitted camera connector/module before use; many pins share FSMC/LCD/timer functions

rtc.rule: Do not reset the backup domain on every boot

discrepancies: Specification p12 table says W25Q64/8MB, but p18 text and schematic p8 U24 say W25Q128/16MB. Model uses U24 schematic; confirm actual chip marking/JEDEC ID if necessary.
Specification p12 says ESP8266 Flash 1MB, schematic p6 U22 is W25Q64 (8MiB); model records schematic, actual fitted variant not electronically verified.
Specification p18 calls AT24C02 2KB (256 bytes). Correct capacity is 2Kbit=256 bytes, also stated in schematic p8.

Latest supplied schematic history adds SIT CAN/485/232 replacement parts (2024-08-26). Header title remains V2.0; several drawing dates are January 2026 despite 2025 filename. Sources identified by SHA-256.
STM32F407 has no dedicated CTSU; capacitive key uses external RC and GPIO/timer.

Schematic p4 U19A symbol prints PC1 at package pin27 and PC0 at pin26, but net labels PC0/PC1 and the vendor IO sheet match ST package pins27=PC0,26=PC1. Model follows net labels and package datasheet.
Existing HardwareHarness CAN portId J1 is retained for compatibility; physical SWD J1 uses portId DUT_1.J1. Existing RS485 IDs retained, labels corrected to physical 1=A,2=B.
RJ45 pins use cable contact J1..J8, not the magnetics' PCB pad numbers. Audio jacks use original schematic solder-pad numbers; those are not TRS contact positions.
